'''Corpsman''' was a rank used in several militaries to denote a medical specialist.

==History==
Corpsmen served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] defenses protecting [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were frequently called upon to see to wounded soldiers fighting the incoming [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].

A notable corpsman was [[Elassar Targon]], who served in that capacity for [[Wraith Squadron]] through the latter years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
